guides.favoredWhen: Outrange him, answer every E with backwards combos, and shove whenever he ults away.

keyTips.text: You outrange and outscale: play your range, never his melee.
If he E's in, double-W Q-E backwards: retreating damage wins the trade.
Keep CS and XP even or better: parity now is sidelane kills later.

tips.text: Short trades only: poke and back off, never extended fighting.
Backwards WEQ every time he E's in: same answer, no exceptions.
When he ults away, shove under his tower immediately: his roam is your CS lead.
Shove on every roam: the wave you crash is damage he never recovers.
Sidelane him later: even-or-better CS plus your range ends it after laning.

guides.favoredWhen: Shove him in, punish every roam with plates, and hold R until the gold card flies.

keyTips.text: The lane is fine but he roams: your job is making every roam cost him.
Always shove: the minions he misses and the plates you take are the matchup.
Hold R until he throws gold card: ulting into a held stun reverses the kill.

tips.text: Avoid his stacked-deck auto: trade only when the glow is gone.
Poke to keep him in lane: chunked HP cannot roam.
Track his R timer and ping every vanish: your team must know before he appears.
Take plates on every roam: shove and hit tower while he shows elsewhere.
Win the map, not the duel: a Twisted Fate who never roams for free is a Twisted Fate who loses.

guides.favoredWhen: Survive to 6 with full HP, trade only backwards, and time R to her W return.

keyTips.text: Basically unplayable lane: play for survival and high-level punishment, not for winning trades.
When she jumps on you, double-W Q-E backwards: retreating damage dodges her W burst.
Stay healthy before 6: the lane only becomes playable once your R answers hers.

tips.text: Trade nothing early: your only job pre-6 is arriving at 6 with full HP.
Combo backwards when she Q-W's in: never stand still to return damage.
After 6, cast R just before she returns with W: she lands back into your damage.
When you R and she W's away, W toward her and Q back to her old W spot: most LeBlancs return.
Hexdrinker covers the burst gap: with it plus backwards combos, post-6 all-ins swing to you.

guides.favoredWhen: Poke from 3, never grant free empowered Qs, and all-in only after his pool with Ignite.

keyTips.text: Respect his early and his scaling: stronger now, outscales later, so your window is the middle.
Never take a free empowered Q: every one you eat buys his scaling time.
All-in only after his pool: R after it, with Ignite already on.

tips.text: From level 3, start poking: with W online your shadows answer his Qs.
Farm First Strike procs while farming: free gold for the mid-game all-in.
Bring your jungler: he has no disengage, so every gank is a kill setup.
All-in the moment pool is spent: R after pool plus Ignite leaves him no escape.
Close before scaling: pool-down Ignite all-ins with jungle help end the lane.

guides.favoredWhen: Dodge Q, respect the wall after 6, and never crack the egg without the kill.

keyTips.text: Dodge Q: it is her main poke and starts everything.
Never pop her egg without the finish ready: the revive punishes half-commits.
Respect her wall: it decides where fights happen.

tips.text: Sidestep Q on cooldown: every miss is lane control you keep.
With your W down, her W-Q is hard to avoid: track your own shadow cooldown.
After 6, watch your W timing: she walls you into R when you commit blindly.
Keep her low: the pressure of a cracked egg shapes the whole lane.
Wall respected plus egg finished: dodge Q, time W, and close only with lethal.

guides.favoredWhen: Stay off the wave, trade only with Bone Plating or Ignite ready, and play for jungle and roams.

keyTips.text: Rarely killable: do not play for the solo kill, play for timers.
Stay off the wave and away from caster minions: her Q resets on minions to reach you.
Trade only with Bone Plating up or Ignite ready: without one she out-trades.

tips.text: Poke, never commit: short shadow Qs are the whole early plan.
Concede CS to keep HP: you need health for jungle plays more than gold.
R dodges her E or removes her Q mark: hold ult for her setup, not yours.
Play for jungle and roam timers: your kills come with help or elsewhere.
Win off her wave: roams and jungle setups decide what the duel cannot.

guides.favoredWhen: Respect the cage, punish it when down, and dodge his R with yours.

keyTips.text: Respect the cage before all-ins: never commit while it is up.
Cage down means run him down: the cooldown is the kill signal.
Your R dodges his R: hold ult to answer, not just to engage.

tips.text: Do not stress early: chip him with shadow poke and wait for spikes.
Farm to Voltaic: with the spike you abuse him.
Edge of Night second: with it his cage cannot catch you after R.
Hunt once Edge of Night lands: spellshield plus shadows leave him no defense.
Cage down plus R-dodge ready: that combination is the kill every time.

guides.favoredWhen: Take TP, eat no Q poke, and stack CS until spikes. Nothing happens in lane.

keyTips.text: Scaling matchup with nothing to do in lane: accept the farmfest.
Do not eat Q poke: every Q is HP you need for later.
No early kills: stay healthy and farm, never force.

tips.text: Doran's Shield start: tank the Qs you cannot dodge.
Avoid long melee trades: short combos only, then out.
Take TP: with no kills available, your pressure goes elsewhere.
Versus AP Malphite, R dodges his R: hold ult for his engage.
Roam or stack CS until spikes: the matchup is won on items and map, not in lane.

guides.favoredWhen: Track daggers, never melee, and answer her R from range.

keyTips.text: Against AP Katarina: dodge daggers and predict her Shunpo landing with Q.
Against AD Katarina: answer her R with yours and W away; play from range, never melee.
Do not R first unless it is a sure kill.

tips.text: Respect her early levels and daggers; your range wins trades after that.
Track daggers and stand away from them.
After she Ws, step back so she cannot E onto you.
W away from her R; re-engage after it ends.
Win from range: never give her the melee fight she wants.

guides.favoredWhen: Bait Q at max range, combo only when Q and E are both down, and respect her early autos.

keyTips.text: Respect her early auto and Q damage: the first levels belong to her ball.
Bait Q by stepping to max range and back, or faking last hits: every missed Q is your opening.
Combo only when both Q and E are down: without them she cannot fight back.

tips.text: Boots first back: movement is how you keep baiting Q.
Survive to Voltaic: with the spike you poke and kill regularly.
Bait then combo is the whole pattern: Q spent on a fake means shadows land free.
Poke on every cycle after Voltaic: that is when your damage sticks.
Win the bait war: the Orianna who holds Q holds the lane, so never let her.

guides.favoredWhen: Do not walk up early; wait for Voltaic, poke, and sweep shroud.

keyTips.text: Give up early walk-ups: her trades win until Voltaic gives you poke back.
Wait for Voltaic, then poke and find kills.
Sweep before 6 so she cannot hide in shroud.

tips.text: Trade only with shadows before Voltaic: walk-up trades lose until the spike lands.
Never walk up without W ready.
Poke with shadows once Voltaic lands.
Keep distance and punish sudden all-ins; never stand in shroud range.
Kill through poke, not duels: your range wins the long game.

guides.favoredWhen: Play at range, keep his shield down with Q, and buy QSS before his R matters.

keyTips.text: Ward early: his team plays around his R, so track the jungler before he hits 6.
Land Q early and often to keep his passive shield down: combos only land when the shield is gone.
Your window is his E on the wave: combo him while he spends it pushing.

tips.text: Take Scorch: it grinds him through the shield downtime between your Qs.
Play at range and outscale: nothing he does early forces you off the wave.
Buy QSS early: with it his R never holds you, and his one threat is blanked.
Keep punishing his E-windows: every wave he pushes is damage you bank for free.
Outscale and answer the map: with QSS up your R decides fights while his R decides nothing.

guides.favoredWhen: Dodge Q and the lane is free. Engage the moment it misses, never R into it.

keyTips.text: Her Q enables everything: a missed Q removes most of her threat.
Never R while her Q is up: ulting into a held binding reverses the kill.
Engage when she spends Q: the cooldown is your entire window.

tips.text: Stand far back to dodge E: max range is where her poke stops landing.
Respect Q-E-R: a single binding converts into her full combo.
Buy Edge of Night: blanking one Q buys the engage.
Cleanse negates her Q: with it you all-in through the binding.
After Edge of Night the kills are free: dodge Q, shield the next, and R the defenseless Lux.

guides.favoredWhen: Stand off the wave, punish every wasted E, and close with R once Voltaic lands.

keyTips.text: Any gap-close is a kill: with no disengage he cannot shake your R.
Stand away from the wave: force him to choose between poking you and pushing.
His E is his whole defense: wasted E is the all-in signal.

tips.text: Skip First Strike: his range denies the proc.
Buy early boots: every sidestepped Q is free HP.
After Voltaic you farm him: the spike ends his poke phase.
Bring your jungler: no disengage means every gank converts.
Edge of Night second, then hunt: spellshield plus your R closes every fight.

guides.favoredWhen: Respect her held Charm, swap shadows before ulting, and strike when her answers are down.

keyTips.text: Kill angles are rare against a good Ahri: she saves Charm and ult to stop yours.
Never R while her Charm is up; if you must, buffer Q through it.
After she uses an ult dash, W-Q her.

tips.text: Poke with shadows; outside her crowd control the lane is yours.
Threaten swaps so she must hold Charm: a Charm she cannot use freely is half its value.
Swap shadows before ulting: never give her a static R target.
In all-ins, buffer Q as you exit Death Mark.
Close when her answers are down: Charm or ult spent means a free R window.

guides.favoredWhen: Take Bone Plating, answer his Q with backwards combos, and track his E.

keyTips.text: Take Bone Plating: it blunts his all-in.
When he Qs in, double-W Q-E backwards.
Track his E: it is his trade tool and he can dive with it.

tips.text: Trade with Bone Plating up.
Respect his early Q engages; your window is the backwards combo, not the face-up trade.
His E spent is your window: all-in then.
Let him start it: meet every Q engage with the backwards combo.
Win through windows, not duels: E-down plus plating-up is the only go.

guides.favoredWhen: Skip First Strike, farm to Voltaic, and fight only outside his W.

keyTips.text: Do not take First Strike: his E outranges you and wins the trade.
Wait for Voltaic: the spike turns his range edge into your kill window.
Never fight inside his W: wait the field out, then re-engage when it fades.

tips.text: When his Q lands, do not stand for the empowered auto: walk off before it connects.
Farm to Voltaic: his E outranges you, so the lane starts when your spike lands.
When he oversteps, Ignite and stay on him: the full commit is the kill.
All-in sequence: R first, W1 outside his field, auto plus E, W2 out plus Q.
Post-Voltaic fights outside his W are yours: R-first combos with Ignite close every all-in.

guides.favoredWhen: Respect her R and ganks; take TP and win the map, not the duel.

keyTips.text: She is rarely killable: her R plus jungle and support camping beats all-ins.
Do not line up with her and the wave; her Q extends through it.
Good TP matchup: match her map pressure instead of forcing kills.

tips.text: Careful with W usage: she Es onto you when it is down.
Concede kills and farm for TP plays: this lane pays in map pressure.
Track jungle and support: the lane is a gank setup against you.
Shove and look elsewhere when she plays safe: your R finds other lanes.
Win the map: TP plays and roams decide it, not the 1v1.

guides.favoredWhen: Take no early trades, poke only after Voltaic, and answer every engage backwards.

keyTips.text: Strong lane like Sylas: take no early trades, or she snowballs past you.
Poke only after Voltaic: her W shield wins early HP races.
When she jumps in, backwards WEQ instantly: damage while leaving denies her follow-up.

tips.text: Her Q curves from her right side: walk into it to make it miss.
Never all-in while her W shield is up: wait for it to fade, then look.
Hold R to dodge her R: her engage reverses when your ult blanks hers.
Keep poking after Voltaic: every chunked HP bar is an all-in she can no longer take.
Win the patience game: backwards combos plus the R-dodge turn her all-ins into your kills.

guides.favoredWhen: Out-space her poke, punish wasted E, and R through her R.

keyTips.text: Skill matchup: a good Syndra out-spaces you and slightly outranges shadow poke.
Wasted E is the all-in window; W over her E can bait it.
After 6, R through her R: R her as she Rs so she cannot dodge it.

tips.text: Respect early Q poke: trade only after it is down.
Most Syndras are killable: test her spacing early with shadow poke.
Bait E with W movement, then all-in.
Combo after she spends E; her main answer is down.
Kill her repeatedly: she cannot answer chained all-ins.

guides.favoredWhen: Outrange her, take Cleanse, and time shurikens for her R return spot.

keyTips.text: You outrange her: max-range shadows are your safe damage.
Respect bubble and the summoners she picks up: check her spellbook every back.
Take Cleanse: escaping sleep means all-ining freely.

tips.text: Respect her passive autos early: do not walk up for free.
Take Cleanse or TP: the summoner is your safety net.
Time a triple Q on her R return spot: she always comes back to it.
Aim shurikens at her return spot after R: the reappearance is the free hit.
Sleep answered plus return punished: with Cleanse up and Qs timed, her tricks run out.

guides.favoredWhen: Stay off his wave, poke after Voltaic, and punish his forcing.

keyTips.text: Stay away from your own minions: he dashes on them to reach you.
Poke after Voltaic; do not spam W early.
Respect Wind Wall, but sidelane fights are winnable with outplays.

tips.text: Farm and scale; turn the moment he forces a trade onto you.
Poke with Q and hold W early: pre-Voltaic shadows commit you for little damage.
After Voltaic, poke and look for kills.
Take sidelane fights with outplays, respecting Wind Wall.
Outscale to sidelane kills; never force into stacked waves.

guides.favoredWhen: Survive his early with shield and Q-farming, then kill with Voltaic plus R.

keyTips.text: Early favoured to him: high poke means you concede the first levels.
Respect his E engage: the swing is his kill setup.
Ping every roam: his map movement is the real threat.

tips.text: Doran's Shield start: shield the poke you cannot dodge.
Do not die, farm with Q: HP now is kills later.
After Voltaic plus R, look for kills: the spike plus ult flips the lane.
R breaks his E chain: if he grapples, ult to snap it.
Survive then hunt: shielded early plus Voltaic-R timing turns his poke lane into your kills.

guides.favoredWhen: Check his rune early, deny every free passive proc, and answer his E-Q with backwards combos.

keyTips.text: Read his rune in loading screen: Hail of Blades plus E is a dangerous early, Electrocute is a calm poke lane.
Never let him proc his passive for free: keep spacing after his E-Q connects so the third hit never lands.
When he E-Q's in, answer with backwards WEQ: damage while retreating beats his commit.

tips.text: Versus Hail of Blades, concede the early: take no extended trades in the first levels while his attack speed runs.
Versus Electrocute, poke calmly and stack small wins: the lane only kills once you have chunked him.
Keep poking until he is killable: Electrocute lanes are won by accumulated poke, not one engage.
Ignite early in all-ins: cutting his R heal turns his rewind into your kill.
Win by poke into all-in, never by brawling: with Ignite cutting his heal and no free passive procs, your combo decides it.

guides.favoredWhen: Stay off the wave, never R first, and answer every engage with double-W backwards.

keyTips.text: She out-damages you: never take the straight trade.
Stay away from your wave: she E's through it to reach you.
Never R first: she R's back and reverses it.

tips.text: Respect her level-2 burst: give ground at 2.
Poke with range and give no all-in openings: your damage must be free.
Double-W backwards combo when she engages: retreat while landing everything.
You need W plus R: R alone gets countered by hers, so only commit with shadow ready.
Sweeper plus Exhaust close it: stealth denied and burst answered turn her engages into your kills.

guides.favoredWhen: Stand in the wave or far back, trade only after Voltaic, and play the R-steal exchange.

keyTips.text: Stand inside the wave or far back so his E2 cannot reach you.
If he E-W's you, answer instantly with backwards W-Q-E.
Do not trade much before Voltaic: save HP for the poke war after the spike.

tips.text: Farm from max Q range early: walking up feeds his E.
Be positioned to trade back if E2 lands.
If he steals your R: R first and he usually mirrors immediately, then triple-Q him as he appears.
If he Rs first, W backwards and re-engage when W is back.
Save Qs for when he exits his stolen-R animation.
Avoid HP races unless setting up the all-in.

guides.favoredWhen: Never engage into fear. Out-poke her, and all-in only when fear and E are both spent.

keyTips.text: Never engage into fear: her mark wins every contested trade.
Punish spent fear after 6: the window opens when the mark fades.
Fear down plus E wasted is the all-in: both conditions, then commit.

tips.text: Out-poke her early: shadow Qs cost her HP for free.
Save W for empowered fear: dodging it with the swap denies her trade.
Buy Mercs: tenacity shortens every fear you fail to dodge.
Post-6, track fear like a summoner: its absence is your engage timer.
Out-poke into fear-down all-ins: patience with shadows beats her burst windows.

guides.favoredWhen: Win trades with backwards combos; never melee DPS race him.

keyTips.text: If he E's and Q3s onto you, combo backwards and you win the trade.
Never melee DPS race him: your win is the backwards combo, not autos.
After Voltaic the lane is free: keep him off the wave with poke.

tips.text: Trade with backwards combos when he Q's in.
Break contact after your combo lands: staying lets his melee DPS win.
When he E's aggressively, R as he snaps back.
When he ults you, buffer Qs to land both shurikens.
After Voltaic, keep punishing his engages.

guides.favoredWhen: Rush Edge of Night, track his fear E, and engage the moment Q or E is spent.

keyTips.text: His E, purple fear, is the key spell: E down means trade and all-in.
Stay away to avoid his passive proc: spacing denies his bonus damage.
Engage when he uses Q: spent cooldowns are your window.

tips.text: He cannot dodge shadow poke: WEQ from range is free damage.
Hold max range early: distance is what keeps his passive offline.
Rush Edge of Night: with it the lane goes calm.
Cleanse is very strong here: it answers the fear that holds you.
Fear down plus Q down is the kill: layered cooldowns turn every trade into your all-in.

keyTips.text: Farm with Q and autos while protecting health: Zed is item-reliant, so never trade away too much early for a wave that Q can collect.
At level three, poke with W-Q-E or W-E-Q only when the enemy jungler is accounted for and Zed is not pushed into an unsafe position.
Poke opponents toward roughly sixty percent health before level six, then use the W-E-Q just before leveling into the newly available ultimate while the opponent expects the combo to be unavailable.

tips.text: When ahead, shove and roam or coordinate a dive with the jungler; when behind, stay mid, ward the center of the lane, clear quickly, and collect plates instead of following every roam.
Track the enemy jungler and use fog of war to keep Zed's location uncertain before choosing each play.
Open Doran's Blade for the standard setup or Doran's Shield into poke, with Pickaxe, Long Sword, and Refillable Potion as first-buy components.
After either bot-lane tier-one turret falls, swap toward the longer side lane and use the mobility to pressure an opponent with less room to retreat.
Push the side wave before taking nearby enemy jungle camps, gaining experience while denying it to the other team.
Move first or match the opponent's rotation when a play is viable; when it will be over before Zed arrives, stay for wave and plate value instead.
Use deep vision to bait several enemies toward Zed, surviving their response with mobility while teammates take space elsewhere.
For the next objective, side lane on that objective's side so Zed can pressure and still rotate, letting the top laner with Teleport cover the other lane.
In late fights, flank for a high-value target and wait for allied engage or crowd control when possible instead of starting the fight alone.
Check defensive answers such as stasis or Guardian Angel before committing the full combo, choosing the target by current threat and value.
Dodge incoming damage or crowd control with Death Mark's untargetability, then swap back to a shadow when that is the safer exit; a multi-target E shortens Living Shadow's cooldown for the return.
When the enemy frontline blocks access, cast R on a frontliner and send W-Q-E onto a squishy behind them to bypass the line.

itemization.text: Run First Strike with Cash Back, Triple Tonic, Jack of All Trades, Legend: Haste, and Cut Down.

Build Voltaic Cyclosword, Bastionbreaker, Gluttonous Greaves, Lord Dominik's Regards, Edge of Night, and Endless Hunger as the main line, with Gluttonous Greaves, Armored Advance, or Chainlaced Crushers for boots, Serylda's Grudge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Mortal Reminder, or Black Cleaver for armor penetration, and Edge of Night, Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius, Guardian Angel, or Spear of Shojin for late defense by opposing damage.
Start Doran's Blade by default and Doran's Shield into poke pressure.
